A double annular rotor spherical aircraft - China patent

#ufotwitter

📄 CN109878712B — “Electromagnetic Propulsion / Flying Vehicle Concept”

Assignee: Zhejiang Anfu Aviation Technology Co., Ltd. (浙江安浮航空科技有限公司)

🧠 Core Idea

This patent describes a flying craft that uses electromagnetic fields and plasma interactions to generate propulsion instead of traditional propellers or jets.

⚙️ How It’s Supposed to Work

1. Plasma Generation

The craft ionizes air (or gas) to create plasma around or inside the vehicle.
This is usually done with: High voltage electrodes
Strong electromagnetic fields

👉 Plasma = charged particles (ions + electrons)

2. Electromagnetic Acceleration

The system applies electric and magnetic fields to the plasma.

This produces a force via the Lorentz force:Charged particles accelerate when exposed to E + B fields

Accelerated plasma is expelled → creates thrust

👉 This is essentially magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) propulsion

3. Thrust Generation

The moving plasma pushes against surrounding air
Reaction force pushes the craft forward (Newton’s 3rd law)
